bioAdditions: Leopoldo was baptized at San Mango d'Aquino on 25 July 1871 as the son of Fortunato Ferlaino and Rosa Moraca. The godparents were Nicola Perri and his wife Rosa Berardelli. I read the entry on the register photograph (S1, S2). His parents had lost an earlier son named Leopoldo: baptized in February 1870, that child died at five months in July 1870 (S4, S5). The parish index lists his other siblings as Gennaro (1855), Raffaela (1858), Marianna (1865) and Giuseppe Antonio (1868) (S6). His only child baptized at San Mango was Maria Filomena (later Helen), born 8 October 1894 (S7). No church marriage of Leopoldo and Giuseppina Fiorillo appears in the San Mango marriage index for 1885-1920, so they may have married civilly only, or in another parish. The Pennsylvania death-certificate index for 1915 has 'Ferlaino, Leopoldo; 104147; Dickson City; Nov. 2' (S3). Dickson City is a borough adjoining North Scranton. This fixes his death as 2 November 1915, in Pennsylvania rather than Italy, and gives the certificate number.
